text: dsh-message-copy-enhance 是 DSH Web 客户端的复制增强插件。复制助手回答中的选区时，它将内容转成 Markdown 并写入剪贴板，保留链接地址、LaTeX 源码、代码围栏及标题、列表和表格格式。普通文本、用户消息和空选区仍使用浏览器默认复制。适合将回答粘贴到 Markdown 编辑器的用户；无需 API Key、账号或外部服务，可用 DSH 插件命令安装。

dsh-message-copy-enhance improves copying in the DSH web client. Copying a selection from an assistant answer converts it to Markdown, preserving link URLs, LaTeX source, code fences, lists, and tables. Other messages keep normal browser copying. It needs no API key or external service.
复制模型回答时，怎么让链接和公式源码一起保留下来？
我想把 DSH 的回答直接粘贴成格式完整的 Markdown。
能不能复制代码块时保留围栏和语言标记？
把助手消息里的数学公式复制到笔记里，不想只得到排版后的字符。
How can I copy an assistant reply as Markdown with working link URLs?
I want copied math formulas to keep their original TeX source.
dsh-message-copy-enhance 的功能「保留链接」：复制助手回答里的链接时，将可见文字和 href 转成 Markdown 链接。选中包含链接的内容后按复制快捷键即可，剪贴板中得到 [文字](地址) 格式的文本。
dsh-message-copy-enhance 的功能「还原公式源码」：复制助手回答中的 KaTeX 公式时，从 MathML 注释读取 TeX 源码并输出为行内或块级 LaTeX。即使选区只落在公式中间，也会扩展到完整公式再转换。
dsh-message-copy-enhance 的功能「复制代码块」：选中助手回答中的代码并复制，可输出 Markdown 围栏代码块，并尝试从语言 class 或代码块横幅取得语言标签；纯代码元素内部的选区则按原文复制。
dsh-message-copy-enhance 的功能「限定复制范围」：复制监听器只处理起点位于助手消息且该消息含有 Markdown 特征内容的非空选区；用户消息、普通文本和空选区继续使用浏览器默认行为。
dsh-message-copy-enhance 使用前须知：跨越多条消息的选区不会被接管，且代码只依据选区起点所在项判断消息类型；复制代码块时通常只还原选中的行。（见 src/client/index.ts:105-119）
为什么从聊天窗口复制出来的表格和列表会丢格式？
Can I paste a selected response into a Markdown editor without losing formatting?

[English](README.md) · [中文](README_zh.md)

A DeepSeek Harness client UI plugin: **when you select text in a model message and copy it, the clipboard content is rewritten to Markdown**, so links, LaTeX source, code-fence language info, and more are no longer lost.
dsh-message-copy-enhance README · How it works：DSH renders model output via `dsh-client-ui-conversation` → `dsh-client-ui-primitives`:

dsh-message-copy-enhance README · How it works：| Content | DOM shape | Recovery |
|---|---|---|
| Links | `<a href="...">` | Take the `href` directly, output `[label](url)` |
| Inline / block LaTeX | KaTeX-rendered `.katex` / `.katex-display` | Retrieve the **TeX source** from the `<annotation encoding="application/x-tex">` in the MathML branch, output `$...$` / `$$...$$` |
| Code blocks | `.md-code-block` (banner shows the language) + `pre` | Output a fenced code block; the language comes from the `language-*` class or the banner's infostring |
| Headings / emphasis / lists / quotes / tables | Standard HTML | Recovered as GFM |

dsh-message-copy-enhance README · How it works：The plugin listens for `copy` on `document` in the **capture phase**, and takes over only when the selection starts inside a `[data-chat-flow-kind="assistant"]` message and contains markdown-significant elements:

dsh-message-copy-enhance README · How it works：1. Expand the selection to the full `.katex` element (selecting in the middle of a formula still gets the complete source)
2. Clone the selection DOM with `Range.cloneContents()`
3. Recover the markdown with the built-in zero-dependency DOM→Markdown converter (`src/client/toMarkdown.ts`, written in TypeScript, type-erased and inlined into the bundle)
4. `preventDefault()` and write `text/plain` and `text/markdown`

dsh-message-copy-enhance README · How it works：Other selections (user bubbles, tool cards, plain text) and empty selections are completely unaffected; if conversion fails, the default copy behavior is restored automatically.

npm install           # dev deps: typescript / vite / vitest / @types/node / linkedom / @deepseek-ai/cordis (official types)
npm run typecheck     # tsc -p tsconfig.json — full type check (strict)
npm run build         # vite build — bundle src/client into dist/client.js in the DSH module-loader format
npm test              # vitest run — 36 cases (converter / real bundle / package layout)

dsh-message-copy-enhance README · Release：Releases are driven by [release-it](https://github.com/release-it/release-it) with a Conventional Commits changelog. Run from the `main` branch with a clean working tree:

```bash
pnpm release
```

It is **interactive**: first the commits since the last tag are shown as a changelog preview (grouped by type, including the conventional-commits recommended version), then you pick the next version from a prompt (`patch` / `minor` / `major` / pre-release variants / custom). What happens, in order:

dsh-message-copy-enhance README · Release：1. **Checks** (`npm run check:release`): version is valid SemVer, the version is not already published on npm (or there are new commits since its tag), `GITHUB_TOKEN` is set, npm is authenticated; then typecheck and the test suite run.
2. **Prompt** — the changelog preview is printed and the next version is chosen interactively (the recommended bump from conventional commits is shown; `feat` → minor, `fix`/`perf`/`revert` → patch, breaking changes → major).
3. **Changelog** — `CHANGELOG.md` is regenerated from the commits since the last tag, under the chosen version.
4. **Build** — `npm run build` (the DSH module-loader client bundle).
5. **Release** — commit `chore(release): vX.Y.Z`, tag `vX.Y.Z`, push to GitHub, create a GitHub Release (release notes from the changelog), then `npm publish`.

dsh-message-copy-enhance README · Release：- `GITHUB_PAT_TOKEN` exported (a [GitHub PAT](https://docs.github.com/en/authentication/keeping-your-account-and-data-secure/managing-your-personal-access-tokens) — a classic token with `repo` scope, or a fine-grained token with **Contents: Read and write** on this repo; `gh auth token` also works; `GITHUB_TOKEN` is accepted as a fallback), and `npm login`. The collaborator pre-check is skipped (`github.skipChecks`), since fine-grained tokens get a 403 on that endpoint; GitHub still enforces the real permissions when the release is created.
- Commits following [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/); the script only recognizes those types.

dsh-message-copy-enhance README · Release：Useful variants:

```bash
pnpm release:dry                   # dry-run: previews everything without changing anything
pnpm release -- --increment=patch  # skip the prompt and force a patch bump (or minor/major)
pnpm release -- --ci               # fully non-interactive (for CI; falls back to a patch bump)
```

Note: if a `CI` environment variable is set, release-it automatically switches to non-interactive mode.

dsh-message-copy-enhance README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-message-copy-enhance
```

dsh-message-copy-enhance README · Upgrading：```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-message-copy-enhance@latest
```

This package is pre-1.0, and a caret range like `^0.1.0` covers **patch releases only** (`0.1.x`) — a **minor** bump (`0.1 → 0.2`) falls outside the range, so `dsh plugin update` will not pick it up. Upgrade explicitly with `@latest` (or `@<version>`).
dsh-message-copy-enhance README · Usage：**Select** content in any model answer and press `Ctrl/Cmd+C`, then paste into Typora / Obsidian / VS Code / any markdown editor to get the full markdown.

dsh-message-copy-enhance README · Limitations：- Selections **spanning multiple messages** are not intercepted (only selections starting inside an assistant message are handled).
- Links filtered out by the render whitelist (e.g. `file:`, relative links) have no `href` to begin with and cannot be recovered.
- Code blocks only recover the **selected lines** (no forced expansion of the whole block); the language tag is missing when the selected region does not include the banner.
- Elements shown as `.katex-error` (KaTeX render failure) are output as `$source$`.
- Tables are output as GFM pipe tables; `|` is escaped.
